mapper.select: select mn.*, cif.cif_Date as cifDate, cif.Update_User_Id as updateUserId, cif.Update_User_Name as updateUserName, cif.Update_Time as updateTime from Payment_Receipt_History mn left join Claim_Incoming_Funds_Dtl cifd on mn.cifd_id = cifd.id left join Claim_incoming_Funds cif on cifd.cif_id = cif.id where mn.pr_id = #{prId} order by mn.create_time desc
